# Put the frozen core here

Unzip `watch-going-train-core-v1.zip` so this folder contains:

```text
vendor/going-train-core-v1/CORE_SPEC.json
vendor/going-train-core-v1/assets/going-train-core.glb
```

Do not edit those files after they land.
If the zip extracts with an extra wrapper directory, flatten it so the path above is exact (`scripts/check-core.mjs` depends on it).
